package probe

import (
	"os/exec"
	"path/filepath"
	"strings"
	"testing"
)

func TestChildGitOwnsItsRepository(t *testing.T) {
	t.Parallel()
	for _, entry := range (&exec.Cmd{}).Environ() {
		key, _, found := strings.Cut(entry, "=")
		if !found {
			continue
		}
		for _, forbidden := range []string{
			"GIT_DIR", "GIT_WORK_TREE", "GIT_INDEX_FILE",
			"GIT_COMMON_DIR", "GIT_PREFIX",
		} {
			if strings.EqualFold(key, forbidden) {
				t.Fatalf("hook variable reached test: %s", key)
			}
		}
	}
	root, err := filepath.EvalSymlinks(t.TempDir())
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	init := exec.CommandContext(t.Context(), "git", "init", "--quiet", root)
	init.Dir = root
	if out, initErr := init.CombinedOutput(); initErr != nil {
		t.Fatalf("child init: %v: %s", initErr, out)
	}
	show := exec.CommandContext(t.Context(), "git", "rev-parse", "--show-toplevel")
	show.Dir = root
	out, err := show.CombinedOutput()
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("child root: %v: %s", err, out)
	}
	if got := filepath.Clean(strings.TrimSpace(string(out))); got != root {
		t.Fatalf("child root = %q, want %q", got, root)
	}
}
